Processing & security

A clear view of local processing, network requests and the limits of our checks.

Private beta: use synthetic or non-sensitive documents until security and output validation are complete.

Processing model

Browser libraries read local files, render pages and produce downloads. The host authenticates access and serves assets. Build-time dependencies are bundled into local site assets so normal PDF processing does not execute third-party CDN JavaScript. OCR language models and browser-managed translation or summary models may still be requested externally. No independent security audit has been performed.

Verify network behavior

  1. Create a synthetic document containing a unique marker.
  2. Open developer tools → Network, enable Preserve log, and clear the log.
  3. Select the file, run a tool and download its output.
  4. Inspect requests, URLs and bodies for the marker, filenames and document bytes. They should not be transmitted.
  5. Repeat after clearing caches, including OCR. OCR model downloads are expected; document uploads are not.

The focused audit on 2 October 2026 found no document transmission in the tested workflows and no external requests or script execution from the injected HTML sample. These checks do not cover every file or possible transmission path.

Boundaries

  • No encrypted cloud vault, identity verification or cryptographic signature service.
  • Verified sanitization is unavailable and produces no download. Clear info fields removes selected standard metadata only; it does not erase hidden objects or scan for malware.
  • Redaction and pattern detection require independent verification.
  • External dependencies and browser vulnerabilities remain risks.
  • Full offline processing is not currently supported.
